title: REQ · parseGitLsFiles deduplicates conflict stage entries
summary: The listing parser returns each path once even when git lists it at conflict stages 1-3.
description: Context: parseGitLsFiles currently splits NUL-separated output and returns every entry, so a conflicted path appears up to three times, and staged lines of the form '<mode> <sha> <stage>\t<path>' would be returned with their prefix. Desired behavior: strip the stage prefix when present and return unique paths in first-seen order. Why: guard reports and cleanup counts must not be inflated by conflict entries.
acceptance_criteria: Given NUL-separated output where the same path appears three times, when parsed, then the result contains it once.
Given lines like '100644 <sha> 2\tnode_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json', when parsed, then the result is the bare path once.
Given plain unique paths, when parsed, then order and content are unchanged.

out_of_scope: Changing the git command used by checkTrackedFiles

definition_of_done: Parser dedupes and strips stage prefix
